Lina (People Ops): Heads-up — Elena submitted a resignation this morning, effective 10 business days from today. Shes remote in Berlin and asked for a tight, non-public offboarding. Need to coordinate benefits end date, access cutover, and equipment pickup.

Chris (Eng Manager): Noted. Well need a knowledge-transfer doc and a short handoff meeting. I can book a 30min slot tomorrow.

Elena (EE): Thanks all — happy to do the KT and a doc. Prefer last day = 2026-03-19 if that helps scheduling. Im on EU hours.

Lina (People Ops): @Chris please confirm acceptance of last-day. @Sarah can you confirm benefits termination date and COBRA election window for a US-origin contract (employee resides in DE)? Also @Brian for access deprovision timeline and laptop return options in Berlin.

Sarah (Payroll): Im looking — because Elenas payroll record is US-entity but EU location, benefits end is the employees last active day (2026-03-19). COBRA (US) notification must go out within 14 days; election window typically 60 days from the notice. Ill draft the notice and share. Any state-specific exceptions?

Lina (People Ops): Good — thanks. Marking required: final gross paycheck, accrued PTO payout, benefits end = 2026-03-19, COBRA notice to be generated.

Brian (IT): For access: plan below. Can someone confirm the exact last-minute SSO window they want? Some teams prefer immediate cut at EOD, some want a grace for KT.

Chris (Eng Manager): We need a short grace window to allow KT and PR handoffs, 48 hours after last KT session. Elenas OK with visible limited access during that period.

Brian (IT): OK. Proposed deprovision sequence (Ill execute with dena-bot):
```
1) Disable personal admin roles in Okta (sso) at 2026-03-20 09:00 CET
2) Archive GitHub org access + transfer repo OWNERShip to team account
3) Revoke service account tokens and rotate keys used by their automation
4) Remove from internal slack channels and google groups (delayed 48h)
5) Schedule remote wipe & collect laptop via local courier (Berlin pickup window 2026-03-22 to 2026-03-24)
```
I need confirmation for the schedule and courier address.

Elena (EE): That schedule works. For laptop pickup, please use my home address (sent to Lina DM). Sequence fine, but please leave read-only access to repo issues for 7 days.

Lina (People Ops): @Brian please respect read-only note. @Sarah please confirm final comp / PTO payout calculation and whether we pay out accrued days by check or ACH.

Sarah (Payroll): Will calculate final. We default to ACH to employees bank on file unless they request otherwise. Ill post the numbers by EOD tomorrow.

Chris (Eng Manager): Ill prepare a 1pager KT with owners for open tickets and a pinned doc in the team repo. Elena, can you include list of outstanding runbooks?

Elena (EE): Yep will add runbooks + a short video walkthrough for the deployment job.

Lina (People Ops): Action items recap:
• Sarah: COBRA notice + final comp by EOD tomorrow
• Brian: implement deprovision plan, respect 48h soft-delay for Slack/Groups + 7d read-only on issues
• Chris: schedule KT and collect runbook list
• Elena: KT doc + video + DM laptop address to Lina

dena-bot (offboard-bot): Offboarding checklist created: OB-2026-0891. Automated reminders scheduled for 72h and 24h before last access removal.

Brian (IT): Quick Q — any vendor VPN tokens to revoke? Elena, list them in the KT doc and Ill rotate creds.

Elena (EE): One third-party QA service token (cypress-runner). Ill add it.

Lina (People Ops): Thanks team. Ill send a private note to Elena with the formal COBRA timeline and options and post a minimal internal note for security & payroll only. If anyone wants to escalate confidentiality constraints, DM me.

Chris (Eng Manager): Thanks — well get KT done and keep everything tidy. :thumbsup:
